ruling.recommended_action: Uphold the $6.61 cancellation fee; no refund due. Optionally note to Ryde ops that the rider's expectation of a free wait-until-arrival cancellation is not a published rule.

rejected_claims.reason: Ryde publishes no rule allowing free rider cancellation because the driver is still en route / far away; NS-8 (driver-late-vs-ETA) is non-citable and Ryde has no ETA-based waiver. Rider cancelled at 3 min 5 s, past the 3-minute free window, so NS-4 upholds the $6.61 fee.

NS-1/NS-2 apply only when the driver cancels claiming rider no-show; here the rider cancelled, the driver never tapped 'I'm Here' [F4] and the platform never recorded arrival [F3], so the no-show branch is not the operative path (NS-0 routes this to NS-4).
